flags.observation: 114 characters; one of fourteen card lines above 95 (also beats 6, 9, 12, 15, 20, 22, 28, 31, 32). Regression against golden line length.
"So time stops:" three beats after "So the summons arrives:"; the So family opens beats 3, 6, 15, 28, 32, closer than ten lines.
120 characters, the longest line; "But the White Rabbit's delay:" is a verbless fragment that stalls the breath before the card starts.
"Dodo, pigeon, serpent, galaxy belly" is a tag list; KayfabeTip 5 asks for one real picture, here four compete.
"repeat the last sentence" lands as an instruction to players; rulebook voice (also beat 15, "locked out until you solve a riddle").
"Giant" is a game-state term, used twice, plus "grow" and "grows" doubled; the line circles without a picture.
"hides inside the other bottle" adds an image; the card says other cards. "Micro" is a game-state term (A8).
"heads grow, tails shrink, edge" recites the coin-flip mechanic; without the coin the listener gets no picture.
"So the Queen needs new roses" contradicts the card: the paint hides a mistake from the Queen. The bridge twists logic, not story.
Callback "But the Rose Garden's paint:" has no verb and no link to stolen tarts; same template as beat 9, reads as formula.
Fifth "So" opener; outside card text "So" appears five times and "But" three times, above the twice limit.
"The Queen is made of cardboard." is a quiet aside; the outro turn lacks the provocative, satirical edge the frame demands.
